text: Business administration is a comprehensive discipline that studies "how enterprises can operate efficiently and achieve sustainable development". Its core lies in addressing the issue of "how to integrate enterprise resources (human resources, funds, technology, information, etc.) through means such as planning, organization, leadership, and control to maximize the goals". From the team building of start-up companies, to the global strategic layout of multinational enterprises, to the transformation of enterprises in crisis situations (such as the shift of catering enterprises to takeout services during the pandemic), all fall within its research and practical scope. It is both the "operating system" for the stable operation of enterprises and the "adaptable guide" for responding to market changes.
